note: Captured from the hand-written registries before feed migration (Task 6). Do not edit by hand.

sentimentPulse.title: Series-level economic indicators
sentimentPulse.freshnessRationale: CPI and unemployment keep separate observation periods, publication dates and revision status.

editorial.publicationPeriod: Separate latest periods for CPI and unemployment
editorial.revisionStatus: CPI and Labour Force Survey estimates may be revised
editorial.caveat: CPI is monthly and unemployment is a rolling three-month estimate. Their observation periods, publication dates, check dates and revision status stay separate.

gdpTracker.title: Monthly gross domestic product
gdpTracker.freshnessRationale: The rolling ONS bulletin is checked regularly. The observation period is assessed separately from the date of that check.

editorial.publicationPeriod: Latest ONS monthly GDP bulletin edition
editorial.unit: Percentage change in real, seasonally adjusted GDP
editorial.revisionStatus: Early monthly estimate; revised as fuller source data become available
editorial.caveat: The latest monthly movement, three-month comparison and annual movement remain separate; forecasts, nominal totals and international estimates are not mixed into the headline.

employmentStats.title: UK labour market
employmentStats.freshnessRationale: The latest labour-market bulletin is checked regularly, with each observation period shown separately.

editorial.publicationPeriod: Latest ONS UK labour-market bulletin edition
editorial.revisionStatus: Labour Force Survey and vacancy estimates may be revised
editorial.caveat: Employment, unemployment and inactivity use rolling three-month periods. Vacancies come from a separate employer survey and retain their own period.

nationalDebt.title: Public sector net debt excluding public sector banks
nationalDebt.freshnessRationale: Public sector finance data is normally monthly; the window allows for weekends, bank holidays and release-calendar variation.

editorial.revisionStatus: Subject to routine ONS public-sector-finance revisions
editorial.caveat: Public sector net debt excluding public sector banks (HF6W) and the matching percentage-of-GDP series (HF6X) are shown together. Other debt measures are not interchangeable.

taxRevenue.title: Central government receipts
taxRevenue.freshnessRationale: The rolling public-sector-finance bulletin is checked regularly, while its publication period is assessed separately.

editorial.caveat: The monthly receipts measure is not a tax-burden ratio, category breakdown, forecast or average-per-person estimate.

migrationStats.title: Long-term international migration
migrationStats.freshnessRationale: The latest ONS edition is checked regularly, while its publication period is assessed separately.

editorial.publicationPeriod: Latest ONS long-term international migration bulletin edition
editorial.revisionStatus: Official statistics in development; the newest estimates are provisional for one year and earlier periods may be revised
editorial.caveat: Long-term migration estimates cover people moving for 12 months or more. Visa grants and nationality tables are different administrative measures and are not mixed into this headline.

housePriceIndex.title: UK House Price Index
housePriceIndex.freshnessRationale: The latest ONS edition is discovered from the rolling bulletin; the house-price percentage-change series can lag the bulletin's publication.

editorial.publicationPeriod: Latest ONS Private rent and house prices, UK bulletin edition
editorial.unit: Average price (£, headline-only) and annual %-change (with monthly history)
editorial.revisionStatus: UK HPI first estimates are provisional and subject to revision as later transaction data is incorporated
editorial.caveat: The average price level is headline-only and is not presented as a fabricated historical series. The annual percentage-change figure can lag the bulletin's publication by one to two months.

realWages.title: Real-terms growth in average weekly earnings
realWages.freshnessRationale: The latest ONS average weekly earnings bulletin is checked regularly, while its publication period is assessed separately.

editorial.publicationPeriod: Latest ONS average weekly earnings bulletin edition
editorial.revisionStatus: Average weekly earnings are provisional and subject to revision
editorial.caveat: This uses ONS's own CPIH-adjusted real-terms earnings growth figure, not a calculation from separate nominal-pay and inflation series.

electionPolling.title: Primary voting-intention poll publications
electionPolling.freshnessRationale: Each accepted poll retains its original publication date and is withdrawn after 14 days.

editorial.publicationPeriod: Latest verified primary pollster publication inside a 14-day evidence window
editorial.revisionStatus: Individual poll publications are normally final; the site does not revise or average them
editorial.caveat: Each poll is shown separately with fieldwork, sample, question or headline method, commissioner, uncertainty and a direct primary source. One poll is not evidence of a durable trend.

nhsStats.title: Referral-to-treatment waiting times
nhsStats.freshnessRationale: Each accepted RTT publication retains its NHS England publication date and is withdrawn after 45 days.

editorial.publicationPeriod: Latest verified NHS England referral-to-treatment month
editorial.unit: Incomplete pathways, weeks or percentage, as labelled
editorial.revisionStatus: NHS England may revise provider submissions, usually through periodic revision releases
editorial.caveat: The headline counts consultant-led pathways rather than unique people. National figures include estimates for non-reporting acute trusts, while treatment-function rows exclude those estimates.

bettingOdds.title: Strict political betting market snapshots
bettingOdds.freshnessRationale: Each observation retains its original time and is withdrawn after four hours. Older prices are never presented as current.

editorial.publicationPeriod: Latest complete Oddschecker snapshot inside a four-hour observation window
editorial.unit: Decimal odds and raw reciprocal percentage
editorial.revisionStatus: Continuously repriced rather than statistically revised
editorial.caveat: public-data.org shows each named market separately, calculates 100 divided by decimal odds and does not normalize prices to 100%. The results are neither official statistics nor official forecasts. Liquidity, provider coverage, bookmaker margins and market rules affect them; stale, embedded or incomplete prices are unavailable.

editorial.publicationPeriod: Latest verified ONS Crime in England and Wales edition and current MoJ quarterly court publication, shown separately
editorial.unit: Estimated incidents, recorded offences or median days, as labelled
editorial.revisionStatus: Official source publications may be revised; each module retains its own release and observation period
editorial.caveat: Crime Survey estimates, police-recorded offences and court timeliness measure different phenomena and are never added into one total. Regional rankings remain unavailable until one versioned geography and population method is reproducible. Geography is England and Wales.

governmentContracts.title: Government contracts

geography.label: United Kingdom — Find a Tender publication coverage

governmentContracts.freshnessWindow: Within 72 hours of the verified collection
governmentContracts.freshnessRationale: The ranking uses seven complete UTC day shards and can reuse only a still-current accepted publication.
uiSourceLabels: Cabinet Office Find a Tender OCDS award releases

editorial.publicationPeriod: Latest complete seven-day Find a Tender update window, collected in six-hour slices
editorial.unit: Disclosed award value in GBP, excluding VAT where supplied
editorial.revisionStatus: Contracting authorities can publish corrections, updates and later notices; the newest release for each award identity is retained
editorial.caveat: Award values are not invoices or confirmed lifetime expenditure. Framework ceilings, lots and multi-supplier awards may not be fully spent; missing, redacted and non-GBP values are excluded.

geography.label: United Kingdom and twelve named peer countries, with measure-specific coverage

editorial.publicationPeriod: UKHSA COVER 2024/25 and DfE EYFS profile 2024/25
editorial.revisionStatus: UKHSA immunisation data can be corrected; DfE profiles may receive publication updates
editorial.caveat: EYFSP profiles were cancelled during the COVID-19 pandemic (2019/20 and 2020/21). A new EYFS profile baseline was introduced in 2021/22, so earlier and later rates are not directly comparable.

election-polls.title: UK election polling
election-polls.description: Latest verified Great Britain voting-intention polls, shown individually with fieldwork, sample and primary-source links.

betting-odds.title: UK political betting markets
betting-odds.description: Timestamped UK political market prices with raw reciprocal percentages and clear commercial-market caveats.

national-debt.title: UK national debt
national-debt.description: Latest UK public sector net debt observation, percentage of GDP, publication period and direct ONS source.

gdp.title: UK GDP growth
gdp.description: Latest ONS monthly GDP estimate with the monthly, three-month and annual movements kept separate.

economy.title: UK inflation and unemployment
economy.description: Latest CPI inflation and unemployment evidence, each retaining its own period and publication date.

tax.title: UK government receipts
tax.description: Latest central government receipts observation from the ONS public sector finances release.

government-contracts.title: UK government contracts
government-contracts.description: Inspect comparable disclosed procurement awards when this publication is enabled and its source records pass verification.

employment.title: UK employment and unemployment
employment.description: Latest official employment, unemployment, economic inactivity and vacancies evidence with separate periods.

crime-stats.title: Crime in England and Wales
crime-stats.description: Crime Survey estimates, police-recorded offences and court timeliness shown as separate official evidence systems.

nhs.title: NHS waiting times in England
nhs.description: Latest NHS England referral-to-treatment waiting-list evidence, including the publication period and direct source.

migration.title: UK long-term international migration
migration.description: Latest ONS long-term immigration, emigration and net migration estimates with the observation period shown.

house-price-index.title: UK House Price Index
house-price-index.description: Average UK house price and annual house price inflation from the latest ONS Private rent and house prices bulletin.

real-wages.title: UK real wages (CPIH-adjusted)
real-wages.description: ONS's own real-terms regular and total pay growth, adjusted for inflation using CPIH, from the average weekly earnings bulletin.

early-years.title: Early years evidence in England
early-years.description: Child vaccination and school-readiness indicators in England with dated official sources and historical context.

measureDefinitions.label: GDP: monthly growth
measureDefinitions.basis: Monthly change in real gross domestic product at market prices
measureDefinitions.note: Monthly real GDP growth is volatile and subject to revision.
caveats: Early estimate; subject to revision.

measureDefinitions.label: GDP: three-month growth
measureDefinitions.basis: Real GDP growth across the latest three months
measureDefinitions.note: A rolling three-month estimate that can be revised.
caveats: Early estimate; subject to revision.

measureDefinitions.label: GDP: annual growth
measureDefinitions.basis: Change in real GDP compared with the same month one year earlier
measureDefinitions.note: Annual GDP growth is an estimate and can be revised.
caveats: Early estimate; subject to revision.

measureDefinitions.label: CPI inflation
measureDefinitions.basis: Annual change in the Consumer Prices Index
measureDefinitions.note: Lower inflation means prices rise more slowly, not that they have fallen.
caveats: CPI does not describe every household's personal inflation rate.

measureDefinitions.label: Unemployment rate
measureDefinitions.basis: ILO unemployed people as a share of the economically active population
measureDefinitions.note: A rolling three-month Labour Force Survey estimate; subject to sampling uncertainty and revision.
caveats: Survey estimate; subject to sampling uncertainty and revision.

measureDefinitions.label: Employment rate
measureDefinitions.basis: People aged 16 to 64 in employment as a share of the population aged 16 to 64
measureDefinitions.note: A rolling three-month Labour Force Survey estimate; subject to sampling uncertainty and revision.
caveats: Survey estimate; subject to sampling uncertainty and revision.

measureDefinitions.label: Economic inactivity rate
measureDefinitions.basis: People aged 16 to 64 not in the labour force as a share of the population aged 16 to 64
measureDefinitions.note: A rolling three-month Labour Force Survey estimate; subject to sampling uncertainty and revision.
caveats: Survey estimate; subject to sampling uncertainty and revision.

measureDefinitions.label: Vacancies
measureDefinitions.basis: Estimated number of vacant employee jobs
measureDefinitions.note: Vacancies are an estimate of unfilled employee jobs, not a count of unemployed people.
caveats: Survey estimate; subject to sampling uncertainty and revision.

measureDefinitions.label: NHS waiting list
measureDefinitions.basis: Referral-to-treatment waiting pathways, not unique people
measureDefinitions.note: NHS England referral-to-treatment pathways; a person can wait on more than one pathway.
caveats: A person can wait on more than one pathway.

measureDefinitions.label: Debt as a share of GDP
measureDefinitions.basis: Public sector net debt excluding public sector banks divided by GDP
measureDefinitions.note: A fiscal stock-to-GDP ratio, not an annual borrowing flow.
caveats: A fiscal stock-to-GDP ratio, not an annual borrowing flow.

measureDefinitions.label: Public sector net debt
measureDefinitions.basis: Public sector net debt excluding public sector banks, in current prices
measureDefinitions.note: A debt stock in cash terms; it is not the amount borrowed during the month.
caveats: This is a fiscal stock, not an annual borrowing flow.

measureDefinitions.label: Central government receipts
measureDefinitions.basis: Nominal central-government receipts on the ONS accounting basis
measureDefinitions.note: Monthly nominal receipts; not all receipts are taxes. Compare the same month across years to account for seasonality.
caveats: Nominal monthly flow; not all receipts are taxes.

measureDefinitions.label: Net migration
measureDefinitions.basis: Long-term immigration minus long-term emigration
measureDefinitions.note: ONS long-term migration estimates; not a count of small-boat arrivals.
caveats: Provisional official statistics in development; subject to revision.

measureDefinitions.label: Long-term immigration
measureDefinitions.basis: People immigrating to the UK for at least 12 months under the ONS long-term migration definition
measureDefinitions.note: ONS long-term immigration estimates; not a count of all border crossings.
caveats: Provisional official statistics in development; subject to revision.

measureDefinitions.label: Long-term emigration
measureDefinitions.basis: People emigrating from the UK for at least 12 months under the ONS long-term migration definition
measureDefinitions.note: ONS long-term emigration estimates; not a count of all border crossings.
caveats: Provisional official statistics in development; subject to revision.

measureDefinitions.label: Real wages: regular pay growth
measureDefinitions.basis: ONS regular pay growth in real terms, CPIH-adjusted
measureDefinitions.note: ONS's directly published real-terms regular-pay growth figure; provisional and subject to revision.
caveats: Published directly by ONS and subject to revision.

measureDefinitions.label: Real wages: total pay growth
measureDefinitions.basis: ONS total pay growth in real terms, including bonuses, CPIH-adjusted
measureDefinitions.note: ONS's directly published real-terms total-pay growth figure; provisional and subject to revision.
caveats: Published directly by ONS and subject to revision.

measureDefinitions.label: House prices: annual change
measureDefinitions.basis: Annual percentage change in the UK House Price Index
measureDefinitions.note: The HPI change series can lag the bulletin's release month; average price is a separate headline-only value.
caveats: Provisional house-price estimates are subject to revision; the observation period can lag the bulletin date.

measureDefinitions.label: Average UK house price
measureDefinitions.basis: ONS average UK house price for the observation month stated in the UK House Price Index bulletin
measureDefinitions.note: A national average price level, not an estimate of a particular property's value or a household's affordability.
caveats: The latest UK HPI price estimate is provisional and subject to revision; the observation period may lag the bulletin publication date.

measureDefinitions.label: Private rent: annual change
measureDefinitions.basis: Annual change in the ONS Price Index of Private Rents (PIPR)
measureDefinitions.note: PIPR measures changes in rents paid by private tenants; it is not an estimate of an individual household's rent.
caveats: The latest estimates are provisional and subject to revision; Northern Ireland estimates and country-level collection have stated comparability limits.

measureDefinitions.label: Average monthly private rent
measureDefinitions.basis: ONS headline average monthly rent for UK privately rented properties
measureDefinitions.note: An aggregate rental level, not a household-specific rent or affordability measure.
caveats: The latest estimates are provisional and subject to revision; Northern Ireland estimates and country-level collection have stated comparability limits.

measureDefinitions.label: CSEW headline crime
measureDefinitions.basis: Estimated headline crime incidents experienced by households and people aged 16 and over in England and Wales, measured by the Crime Survey for England and Wales
measureDefinitions.note: One value from the latest verified publication; the current public feed does not carry a comparable history.
caveats: Survey estimate; subject to sampling uncertainty. No synthetic crime total is calculated.

measureDefinitions.label: CSEW theft incidents
measureDefinitions.basis: Estimated theft incidents experienced by households and people aged 16 and over in England and Wales, measured by the Crime Survey for England and Wales
measureDefinitions.note: One value from the latest verified publication; the current public feed does not carry a comparable history.
caveats: Survey estimate; subject to sampling uncertainty.

measureDefinitions.label: CSEW other household theft
measureDefinitions.basis: Estimated other household theft incidents experienced in England and Wales, measured by the Crime Survey for England and Wales
measureDefinitions.note: One value from the latest verified publication; the current public feed does not carry a comparable history.
caveats: Survey estimate; subject to sampling uncertainty.

measureDefinitions.label: CSEW fraud incidents
measureDefinitions.basis: Estimated fraud incidents experienced by households and people aged 16 and over in England and Wales, measured by the Crime Survey for England and Wales
measureDefinitions.note: One value from the latest verified publication; the current public feed does not carry a comparable history.
caveats: Survey estimate; subject to sampling uncertainty.

measureDefinitions.label: CSEW computer misuse incidents
measureDefinitions.basis: Estimated computer misuse incidents experienced by households and people aged 16 and over in England and Wales, measured by the Crime Survey for England and Wales
measureDefinitions.note: One value from the latest verified publication; the current public feed does not carry a comparable history.
caveats: Survey estimate; subject to sampling uncertainty.

measureDefinitions.label: CSEW violence incidents
measureDefinitions.basis: Estimated violence with or without injury incidents experienced by people aged 16 and over in England and Wales, measured by the Crime Survey for England and Wales
measureDefinitions.note: One value from the latest verified publication; the current public feed does not carry a comparable history.
caveats: Survey estimate; subject to sampling uncertainty.

measureDefinitions.label: CSEW criminal damage incidents
measureDefinitions.basis: Estimated criminal damage incidents experienced in England and Wales, measured by the Crime Survey for England and Wales
measureDefinitions.note: One value from the latest verified publication; the current public feed does not carry a comparable history.
caveats: Survey estimate; subject to sampling uncertainty.

measureDefinitions.label: Police-recorded crime excluding fraud and computer misuse
measureDefinitions.publisher: Office for National Statistics · Home Office source data
measureDefinitions.basis: Offences recorded by police in England and Wales, excluding fraud and computer misuse
measureDefinitions.note: Police-recorded offences are a separate administrative measure; changes can reflect reporting and recording practices.
caveats: Police-recorded crime is not a measure of all crime experienced.

measureDefinitions.label: Police-recorded homicide offences
measureDefinitions.basis: Homicide offences recorded by police in England and Wales
measureDefinitions.note: Police-recorded offences are a separate administrative measure; changes can reflect reporting and recording practices.
caveats: Police-recorded crime is not a measure of all crime experienced.

measureDefinitions.label: Police-recorded knife or sharp-instrument offences
measureDefinitions.basis: Knife or sharp-instrument offences recorded by police in England and Wales
measureDefinitions.note: Police-recorded offences are a separate administrative measure; changes can reflect reporting and recording practices.
caveats: Police-recorded crime is not a measure of all crime experienced.

measureDefinitions.label: Police-recorded firearms offences
measureDefinitions.basis: Firearms offences recorded by police in England and Wales
measureDefinitions.note: Police-recorded offences are a separate administrative measure; changes can reflect reporting and recording practices.
caveats: Police-recorded crime is not a measure of all crime experienced.

measureDefinitions.label: Police-recorded personal robbery offences
measureDefinitions.basis: Robbery of personal property recorded by police in England and Wales
measureDefinitions.note: Police-recorded offences are a separate administrative measure; changes can reflect reporting and recording practices.
caveats: Police-recorded crime is not a measure of all crime experienced.

measureDefinitions.label: Police-recorded shoplifting offences
measureDefinitions.basis: Shoplifting offences recorded by police in England and Wales
measureDefinitions.note: Police-recorded offences are a separate administrative measure; changes can reflect reporting and recording practices.
caveats: Police-recorded crime is not a measure of all crime experienced.

measureDefinitions.label: Magistrates’ courts: median charge-to-completion time
measureDefinitions.basis: Median days from charge to completion for completed magistrates’ court cases in England and Wales
measureDefinitions.note: Court timeliness is a separate, backward-looking justice measure, not a crime rate.
caveats: Completed cases only; do not combine with victimisation or recorded-offence measures.

measureDefinitions.label: Crown Court: median charge-to-completion time
measureDefinitions.basis: Median days from charge to completion for completed Crown Court cases in England and Wales
measureDefinitions.note: Court timeliness is a separate, backward-looking justice measure, not a crime rate.
caveats: Completed cases only; do not combine with victimisation or recorded-offence measures.

measureDefinitions.label: Crown Court: median offence-to-completion time
measureDefinitions.basis: Median days from offence to completion for completed Crown Court cases in England and Wales
measureDefinitions.note: Court timeliness is a separate, backward-looking justice measure, not a crime rate.
caveats: Completed cases only; do not combine with victimisation or recorded-offence measures.
